subject.gist: After a breakup, Margo taught herself to turn a shed on her mother’s land into a home; the hired plumbing was what failed.

story.text: After a breakup leaves her on one income, Margo turns a shed on her mother's land into a home she can own outright. She makes the job manageable by treating it as a thousand tiny projects, learning as she goes. Colourful wallpaper and salvaged finds give it her personality, while a full-size oven, queen bed and bathtub make it comfortable. The surprise is the plumbing: the one job she hires out fails and needs another team to fix it. She spends around $47,000 altogether. She still misses a dishwasher, but waking up surrounded by her own handiwork makes her proud enough to do it again.
